latency_note: Per-query latency measures the Chroma similarity search only (it excludes query-embedding time); it is wall-clock and so varies slightly run-to-run, unlike the deterministic hit-rate/MRR.
cost_note: Retrieval uses a local sentence-transformers model; no API cost per query. LLM answer/judge cost is reported separately and only when an LLM API key is set (default provider: Gemini free tier, $0).
